chunks.subject: AP Research
chunks.title: Academic Paper exemplar — Sample E, 3/5
chunks.content: Sample E scored 3/5 (Ineffectual Argument for a New Understanding). Topic: advertising for sports betting and its effects. The paper has a narrowing focus and a method, but the argument for a new understanding is ineffectual — insufficiently supported or not clearly conveyed by the evidence/analysis. Illustrates the 3 band: a real inquiry and method, but the new-understanding argument does not land.
